fusions.name: Stampede Circuit
fusions.desc: Drives the herd through a cone 4 tiles long ahead of you, dealing 28 damage to everything in it. When it hits, every ally deals 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Herd-Pace Gore
fusions.desc: Gores the target for 7 damage and leaves it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back. Its damage rises 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

fusions.name: Moving as One
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Chewing the Cud
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once and heal you for 5% of your maximum health per stack (30% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
